name: cpanel-hosting-deploy
description: Safe cPanel deployment and remote synchronization for Cursor with configurable SECURED, CUSTOM, and OFF protection modes.

CPANEL_CONFIG_CONNECTION_NAME.title: Connection name
CPANEL_CONFIG_CONNECTION_NAME.description: Optional connection name. Leave blank to use Default.

CPANEL_CONFIG_HOST.title: cPanel host
CPANEL_CONFIG_HOST.description: cPanel URL, for example https://example.com:2083. Leave blank until you configure a connection.

CPANEL_CONFIG_USERNAME.title: cPanel username
CPANEL_CONFIG_USERNAME.description: cPanel account username. Leave blank until you configure a connection.

CPANEL_CONFIG_REMOTE_ROOT.title: Remote root
CPANEL_CONFIG_REMOTE_ROOT.description: cPanel home directory, for example /home/username. Leave blank until you configure a connection.

CPANEL_CONFIG_API_TOKEN.title: cPanel API token
CPANEL_CONFIG_API_TOKEN.description: cPanel API token. Leave blank until you configure a connection.

CPANEL_CONFIG_PROTECTION_MODE.title: Protection
CPANEL_CONFIG_PROTECTION_MODE.description: Protection mode: SECURED, CUSTOM, or OFF. Defaults to OFF for backward-compatible core behavior.
